title: ALIGNING VISUAL CONTRASTIVE LEARNING MODELS VIA PREFERENCE OPTIMIZATION

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated by testing the model's association of gendered captions (e.g., 'The man/woman is <activity>') with images of individuals in various occupations using the VL-Bias dataset, and measuring the ability to neutralize or reverse these associations via preference optimization.

Measured by evaluating the model's classification accuracy on images containing misleading overlaid text (typographic attacks) to determine its inductive bias/tendency to prioritize written text over visual content.
